content.text:
The site looks like the approved screenshots again. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass. I fixed two bad values in `site/css/styles.css`:

- **Navbar position (line 3749):** `.navbar` had `position: absolute`, so it was taken out of the page flow and overlapped the content below it. I changed it to `position: relative`.
- **Heading line height (line 119):** the shared heading rule (`h1`–`h6`) had `line-height: 1.8`, which made the headings too tall and pushed the page down. I changed it to `1.2`.

The repo has only one commit, so I found these by comparing the screenshots rather than reading a diff. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
